details:
- rebuild with newer golang version 1.22.9-1.el9_2.tuxcare.els30 to fix the following CVE's
  - CVE-2026-78667: limit the number of ranges parsed from a Range header in
    net/http FileServer, ServeContent and ServeFile
  - CVE-2026-78669: make HTTP/2 SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE changes O(1) to
    prevent CPU exhaustion by a peer sending many SETTINGS frames
- revert CVE-2026-83663 patch: grafana never creates the vulnerable thrift
  framed and header transports, so the code is not reachable
